findings.reader: A disciplined, well-scoped dated news piece: it reports the September 13 conditional financing accurately, translates the filing's Fully Self Training vision into a concrete causal loop, and rigorously maintains the plan-versus-demonstrated-capability boundary. Terms are defined in context, the reader gets a specific work-life scenario and a reusable three-question evidence method, and both explain-back and a novel robotics transfer succeed. No failure families present.
findings.facts: Factually clean: all ten claims — identity, ~US$5B conditional financing, 60% allocation, placing and bond definitions, separate conditions, the Fully Self Training vision, its three intended mechanisms, manual spot-checking, and the no-demonstrated-capability boundary — are directly supported by the September 13 HKEX filing with limits preserved. The article never overstates the filing's intent-only content, and the library link (P010) is correctly bounded as background, not proof.
